Name: L_Pelvis
Description: This will create a Pelvis System to connect your legs

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  This will create a Pelvis System to connect your legs.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- Mirror: choose one option (for example: True, False, Right_Only).
- CtrlType: choose one option (for example: hexagon, sphere, cube, square).
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- SetGameParent: set the node/object name this block should use.
- Template parent examples: L_Pelvis_Jnt, L_Pelvis_Ctrl, L_LegSlideSlideDriver_Loc.

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
